configurations.name: api
runtimeArgs: set -a; [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; [ -f frontend/.env.local ] && . ./frontend/.env.local; set +a; export AMICUS_PORT=${AMICUS_PORT:-8010}; exec .venv/bin/python -m api.server

configurations.name: frontend
runtimeArgs: export NEXT_PUBLIC_AMICUS_API_URL=${NEXT_PUBLIC_AMICUS_API_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8010}; exec npm --prefix frontend run dev
